scan.title: Meet the Ocean Family!
scan.subtitle: Find the right animal and habitat!
sentences: Welcome to the ocean! There are so many amazing animals here.
Whales are the biggest animals in the ocean. They swim slowly and eat small fish.
Sharks are fast and strong. They live in oceans and deep seas all around the world.
Dolphins are clever and friendly. They live in oceans and sometimes in rivers too.
Sea turtles are slow on land but they swim beautifully in the sea. They love warm lagoons.
Jellyfish have no bones. They float and splash in the ocean. Some are very dangerous!
Octopuses have eight arms. They hide in rocks near the sea floor. They are the cleverest animals in the sea!
Crabs crawl on the sea floor and on the beach. They live in the sea and on the sand.
Starfish live on the ocean floor. They are the most colourful animals on the sea floor.
Seals dive and jump in the sea. They also love to rest on rocks near the beach.

Yunuslar zeki ve arkadaş canlısıdır. Okyanuslarda ve bazen nehirlerde de yaşarlar.

scan.title: Dangers in the Ocean
scan.subtitle: Find the right danger and animal!
sentences: The ocean is a beautiful place — but it is in danger. Let's find out why!
Plastic is one of the biggest dangers for marine animals. Fish and turtles eat plastic by mistake.
Waste from cities goes into rivers and lakes. Then it reaches the sea and the ocean.
Fishing nets are a big problem too. Dolphins and sea turtles get trapped in them.
Pollution from factories and ships makes the water dirty. Marine animals cannot live in dirty water.
Hunting is another danger. People hunt whales and sharks for food or sport. This is very wrong!
Climate change makes the ocean warmer. Jellyfish and coral cannot survive in warm water.
You mustn't throw plastic into the sea. You mustn't leave waste on the beach either.
Seals and starfish need clean water to dive, splash and crawl safely.
Remember: we share this planet with all marine animals. We must protect them!
translations: Okyanus güzel bir yer — ama tehlike altında. Nedenini öğrenelim!
Plastik, deniz hayvanları için en büyük tehlikelerden biri. Balıklar ve kaplumbağalar yanlışlıkla plastik yiyor.
Şehirlerden gelen atıklar nehirlere ve göllere giriyor. Sonra denize ve okyanusa ulaşıyor.
Balıkçı ağları da büyük bir sorun. Yunuslar ve deniz kaplumbağaları onlara takılıyor.
Fabrikalar ve gemilerden gelen kirlilik suyu kirletiyor. Deniz hayvanları kirli suda yaşayamaz.
Avcılık başka bir tehlike. İnsanlar yiyecek veya spor için balina ve köpekbalığı avlıyor. Bu çok yanlış!
İklim değişikliği okyanusları ısıtıyor. Denizanaları ve mercanlar ılık suda hayatta kalamaz.
Denize plastik atmamalısın. Sahilde atık da bırakmamalısın.
Foklar ve denizyıldızları güvenle dalış yapabilmek, sıçrayabilmek ve emekleyebilmek için temiz suya ihtiyaç duyuyor.
Unutma: bu gezegeni tüm deniz hayvanlarıyla paylaşıyoruz. Onları korumalıyız!

A beach house is a house on or near the beach. There are a lot of beach houses on the Aegean coast.

A lake house is a house next to a lake. There are many lake houses in the mountains of Türkiye.
Lake houses are quiet and peaceful. There is not much noise — only birds and water.
A houseboat is a home on the water. People live on boats on rivers, lakes and canals.
There are not many houseboats in Türkiye, but there are a lot of them in the Netherlands and England.
